description: This script tests whether Git correctly preserves CRLF line endings in the context of creating archives (tar and zip). It sets up a sample file with CRLF line endings, commits it to Git, then creates and verifies tar and zip archives to ensure the content remains unchanged.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with setup, a command, and validation steps.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to ensure unique commit timestamps.
